title: observability-spec template variables
description: Values for templates/observability-spec.md.j2 and templates/observability-spec.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from observability-spec.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

deployment_environment.title: Deployment environment
deployment_environment.description: What goes in `deployment.environment` - prod, staging, a named region? This is the attribute every dashboard filters on first.

otel_sdk.title: Otel sdk
otel_sdk.description: Which OTel SDK and version does this service use? Name the language binding and a pinned version - propagation bugs are almost always version-specific.

otlp_endpoint.title: Otlp endpoint
otlp_endpoint.description: Where does this service export spans and metrics to - the collector endpoint, host and port included?

p99_ms.title: P99 ms
p99_ms.description: What p99 latency, in milliseconds, is the SLO target for this service? The number the alert below fires against, not an aspiration.

service_version.title: Service version
service_version.description: What goes in the `service.version` resource attribute? Whatever your build stamps, and it must change on every deploy or you cannot tell two releases apart in a trace.

system_name.description: Which service does this spec cover? Use the name that appears in `service.name` on every span, or the traces and this document describe two different things.
